sentence: AI-powered pricing shows the same order: the bigger and more productive players adopt first, then grow faster in sales, employment and markups
passage: [Adams et al. (2026), p. 1] "At the firm level, larger and more productive firms are more likely to adopt AI pricing. Firms that adopted AI pricing experienced faster growth in sales, employment, assets, and markups, and their stock returns are also more responsive to high-frequency monetary policy surprises than non-adopters."

gemini.note: The passage states that larger, more productive firms are 'more likely' to adopt AI pricing, which is a probabilistic claim that does not explicitly support the definitive or chronological claim that they 'adopt first'.
